description: Choose how long this company's chats are kept — the company's owner only. 'days' 30, 90 or 365: within the hour every message older than that is erased with its files, in every chat of the company, for good, and so on from then; a line in the company's journal says how many went. Omit 'days' for as long as the company is (the default), which erases nothing. An issue made of a message keeps its words. Ask the owner before shortening it: what is erased does not come back.
name: set_chat_keeping
title: Set chat keeping
